title: Where the students who left went
subtitle: Share of the 6,400 Austin ISD students who did not return this year, by destination
alt: Bar chart of where the roughly 6,400 Austin Independent School District students who finished last school year and did not return for 2026-27 went, as Chief Financial Officer Katrina Montgomery reported to trustees on September 24, 2026. Forty-one percent left to a destination the district cannot identify. Thirty-nine percent relocated outside the district, the state or the country. Twenty percent transferred to charter, private, virtual or home schooling. The figures exclude students who graduated.
